PUBLIC HEARING
Z21-0019
"1000 Gade Rd - PSA and relaxing a rezoning condition."
B. Hutchins advised the public of the process to participate in the Public Hearing.
The Mayor opened the Public Hearing for Z21-0019 at 5:59 pm.
Director of Planning Matthew Baldwin advised that 1103548 BC Ltd has applied to amend a rezoning
condition secured by Council as part of a previous rezoning application, Z06-0013, for the property located
at 1000 Gade Road, which is currently owned by the City.
 
Minutes of the Special Council Meeting
May 10, 2021
Page 3 of 17
Among other conditions, the requirements of the zoning of the property under file number Z06-0013
included a 10-16m landscaped buffer along the southern and eastern property lines of the parent parcel
from which 1000 Gade Road was subdivided. This buffer has already been implemented as part of previous
phases of subdivision along the eastern boundary and portions of the southern boundary of the parent
parcel. The only remaining portions of this buffer apply to the southern boundary of the subject property,
Council approved a purchase and sale agreement on February 16, 2021, to sell the subject property to
1103548 BC Ltd. As part of the purchase and sale agreement, this buyer requested that Council consider
reducing the 10-16m buffer to 5m. A staff report outlining the details of this request, and illustrating the
proposed plans for the property and 5m buffer area are included in this agenda.
Under the purchase and sale agreement, Council is obligated to consider this request, but is not obligated
to approve it in order for the purchase to complete.
This is being proposed in order to allow for the development of a private school, accessory dormitories, a
sports field as well as community amenities.
As part of this amendment, a public hearing is required in accordance with the regulations of the Local
Government Act.
This proposal is consistent with the Official Community Plan.
Notifications and advertisements have been placed as required by the Local Government Act.
The Mayor called a first time for presentations.
S. Briar, Valley Mobile Home Park - Lives directly below the development. Only a few people affected by the
proposal received a letter. Reduced variance should be tabled before voting. Seniors require more than 5m
grass barrier. Will not feel secure in the area. Privacy will be invaded by proposed dormitories. Compromise
to 10m variance. The possibility of a retaining wall.
Mayor Young called a second time for presentations.
S. Erb, 935 Gade Rd - Live on the edge of Gade and pleased about the development. The buffer zone was
the main reason we purchased the property where we did. Concerned about a street being put in if the
buffer zone is reduced.
C. Conn, 2431 Echo Valley Dr - Not against development. Inappropriate for a boarding school to be in this
neighborhood. I understand traffic issues with a school in a neighborhood and not enough parking.
Developers should work within the parameters they have. A designated park area.
M. Ferris, 981 Gade Rd - All for keeping the original buffer. Community trail being implemented so buffer is
required. We lack playground park for this area. There is s lack of access.
Mayor Young called a third and final time for speakers.
 
Minutes of the Special Council Meeting
May 10, 2021
Page 4 of 17
A. De Medeiros, 2313 Echo Valley Dr - Echoing other callers. Seeing pickup of traffic. Adding additional
traffic for a school will be overwhelming. No space for children to play.
T. Hallihan, 52-2500 Florence Lake Rd - Agrees with neighbour comments. Submission shows photos of
property lines that will require variances. Looming dormitories over neighbours. Notation of measurements
to slope. There is going to some issues if they put landscaping on the slope. No corridor. Concerned about
right to privacy. Take another look and do a survey. the development doesn't fit in the area.
W. Schmidt, 88-2500 Florence Lake Rd - On behalf of a lot of residents. The buffer changes the feeling of
the area. Appropriate if the buffer stayed. Concerned about public access increasing theft.
A. Labrecque, 95-2500 Florence Lake Rd - On behalf of homeowners in the park. Concerned about the
dormitory being close to residents, privacy for Mobile Park, after hour care of sport field, and building
height.
R. Habgood, 65-2500 Florence Lake Rd - We have always thought the area up top was set aside for public
use, that the area would be set aside for the children in the area. Buffer zone is too little. Bigger issues, the
teens and preteens have no where to go.
